## Outreach - Setup
Run manually once. Safe to re-run. Everything lives in **n8n - Switch**.

- Creates Contacts, Outreach, Mail Log, Outreach Templates, Outreach Config, Outreach Plan tabs
- Adds companyId / isPriority / outreachStatus / outreachAt / applied to **Result**, companyId to **Low Match**, Aliases to **Companies**
- Seeds config (mode = DRY_RUN) and 6 templates
- First run only: marks every existing job LEGACY and copies the old Cold Mailing recruiters (Switch Contacts, read-only) into Contacts as LEGACY with hold = Y. Gmail is not read.
